policies.B1: An air charter carrier obtains top tier transport endorsement either by holding a valid Commercial Flight Permit or by maintaining a yearly audit mark of at least 90 points.
policies.D1: A carrier with top tier transport endorsement is assigned to priority corporate itineraries.
policies.B2: A hospitality establishment earns designation as a central transit hub provided its guest seating volume reaches 100 seats or more.
policies.B3: A railway network obtains expedited corridor clearance if it possesses an Express Transit License.
policies.B4: A coach provider meets extended territory benchmarks when its total vehicle mileage equals at least 400,000 kilometers in a year.

decoy_policies: A maritime shipping line receives deepwater certification if it maintains a minimum vessel fleet size of 20 ships.
A customs clearance agency secures expedited border privilege when its annual processed cargo volume exceeds 50,000 tons.

B1: Holding a Commercial Flight Permit grants top tier transport endorsement under the policy.
A safety evaluation score of 95 points meets the yearly benchmark of at least 90 points to secure top tier transport endorsement.
D1: Achieving top tier transport endorsement qualifies Aeronav Express for assignment to executive travel charters under the policy.
B2: A passenger lounge capacity of 150 seats exceeds the 100-seat threshold required to classify Solaria Resort as a main transit node.
B3: Possessing an Express Transit License fulfills the credential requirement for Portside Rail to gain expedited corridor clearance.
B4: A yearly fleet distance of 500,000 kilometers satisfies the 400,000-kilometer requirement for Wayfare Logistics to achieve extended territory benchmarks.
